description: Renders the central 24 seconds of the track through two to six presets side by side and reports each preset's loudness with a link to listen. Free, limited to 6 runs per day. Choose from these results rather than guessing, and rather than paying a credit to audition a style.

audio_url.description: Track address as a public https link: a direct file (wav, mp3, flac, m4a) or a sharing link, which the server opens for you.

styles.description: Two to six preset names (see list_presets). Left out, the server tries edm, pop, rnb and standard.

name: preview_styles
title: Short audition of several presets
